# HR Quarterly Review and Insurance Optimization Tasks

This document details essential HR tasks for ongoing monitoring and strategic adjustments:

*   Monitor career development quarterly.
*   Review medical insurance based on audit findings.
*   Optimize medical insurance for strategy 2026.
*   Update medical insurance based on audit findings.
*   Investigate annual leave quarterly.
